preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through transferOwnership)

exploit_hint: As owner, call setMarketingWallet() to set attacker's address as marketing wallet, then call setPercentageOfLiquidityForMarketing(100) to direct all swap fees to marketing wallet. Wait for normal trading activity to accumulate fees in contract, then trigger swapAndLiquify via a transfer that meets the minimum token balance condition, causing all BNB from swaps to be sent to attacker's address as marketing fees.
